resources.string:
AstroClock measures time by astronomical standards.

The shortest hand shows the position of the sun during a day. Unlike an normal hour hand, this hand turns only once in 24 hours.
Smaller hands show the moments of sunrise and sunset.

The middle hand shows the phase of the moon. It turns every 29.5 days

The longest hand shows the position of the earth in its orbit around the sun. It turns every 365.25 days

Like a normal clock, the hands rotate in clockwise direction.

Select checkboxe in the alarms section for recurring audible notifications.

To install the AstroClock widget on your home screen, long press the home screen, then select widgets, then select AstroClock.\nThe AstroClock widget requires a two by two empty icon space.
